## Services
- /services/panel-upgrade : Panel upgrades (often 100A to 200A) and replacement of failed, burned, or obsolete panels, including Federal Pacific and Zinsco. Permits and inspection.
- /services/electrical-troubleshooting : Electrical troubleshooting and repairs: flickering lights, dead circuits, breakers that will not hold, partial outages.
- /services/gfci-outlet-repair : GFCI diagnosis, repair, and installs in kitchens, baths, garages, outdoors.
- /services/ev-charger-installation : Home EV charger installation (Level 2) with dedicated circuit and permits when required.
- /services/dedicated-circuits : Dedicated circuits for EV chargers, hot tubs, ranges, shops, offices.
- /services/electrical-rewiring : Full and partial rewiring, knob-and-tube and aluminum.
- /services/surge-protection : Whole-home surge protection at the panel.
- /services/electrical-inspection : Electrical safety inspections with written report.
- /services/lighting-installation : Recessed lighting, ceiling fans, outdoor and smart lighting.
- /services/emergency-electrician : Call to ask about urgent help for sparking panels, burning smells, and power loss, when available.
